requirements.text: Introduce a Decision compiler and decision_build for routine intent-to-knowledge work with explicit user semantic approval and gateway-validated KB updates.
Route accepted decisions by product-first or system-first abstraction and propagate impact to the opposite layer with explicit direction and no-impact evidence.
Make core system diagrams the system navigation spine and ontology.
Require diagram_refs for system docs, with rich diagram node types and requires_doc for mandatory detail docs.
Simplify default graph around Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof while retaining exact trace/audit lenses.
Limit parallelism to read-only preflight/draft lanes and keep canonical promotion serial.
Use risk-tiered gates so users approve semantic decisions/escalations and gateways validate lower-layer artifacts.
Run the self-refactor through current CodeWiki in compatibility/freeze mode with vNext behind compatibility until validated.
Reduce vNext public/agent tool surface to fewer workflow tools and move low-level primitives internal or compatibility-only.

summary: Accepted CodeWiki vNext operating model: decision compiler, abstraction-aware product/system propagation, diagram-backed system KB, simplified graph, parallel preflight, risk-tiered gates, self-refactor compatibility mode, and reduced tool surface.

diff_table.current_state: Feedback and documentation are separate compiler loops.
diff_table.desired_state: Introduce a Decision compiler that combines user interaction, KB preflight, accepted semantic rows, product/system KB updates, and one decision_build for routine intent-to-knowledge work.
diff_table.rationale: Remove one handoff, reduce translation drift, and keep KB updates close to accepted intent.
diff_table.risk: High: requires proposal/accepted phases and row-to-KB validation.

diff_table.current_state: Product/system entry abstraction is not explicit in compiler routing.
diff_table.desired_state: Classify product-first versus system-first decisions and propagate impact to the opposite abstraction layer with direction and no-impact evidence.
diff_table.rationale: Different users enter at different abstraction levels; bidirectional propagation preserves alignment.
diff_table.risk: Medium: needs loop prevention and ownership rules.

diff_table.current_state: System diagrams exist but are not mandatory system ontology.
diff_table.desired_state: Make context map, component/container map, key sequence flows, data/domain model, and state/lifecycle map the system navigation spine.
diff_table.rationale: Core diagrams improve overview, onboarding, architecture review, and drift detection.
diff_table.risk: Medium: diagrams must remain editable and audited against docs/code.

diff_table.current_state: System docs can exist without machine-checkable diagram grounding.
diff_table.desired_state: Require system docs, except overview and diagram README, to declare valid diagram_refs; diagram nodes may use requires_doc to make detail docs mandatory.
diff_table.rationale: Prevents orphan docs without forcing every diagram node to have prose.
diff_table.risk: Medium: diagrams need rich node types for components, flows, domain entities, lifecycles, policy boundaries, artifacts, adapters, actors, and external systems.

diff_table.current_state: Generated graph mostly exposes docs, code paths, tests, markdown links, and doc-code edges; artifact internals can clutter default context.
diff_table.desired_state: Refactor graph lenses around Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof; parse decision_builds and diagrams as first-class nodes; collapse builds/validation in default view but expand in trace/audit lenses.
diff_table.rationale: Keep default graph simpler and lower-token while retaining exact traceability.
diff_table.risk: Medium: gateways still need exact evidence refs and content proof.

diff_table.current_state: Compiler parallelism could create write races.
diff_table.desired_state: Use parallel read-only preflight/draft lanes only, with proposal hashes, snapshots, invalidation, and runtime-only storage; promote canonical truth serially.
diff_table.rationale: Find blockers early without creating half-written truth or drift.
diff_table.risk: Medium: speculative drafts can become stale or wasted.

diff_table.current_state: Semantic work often follows similar ceremony regardless of risk, and user review can leak into task/code layers.
diff_table.desired_state: Use risk-tiered gates: users approve semantic decisions and escalations; gateways validate KB diffs, planning/tasks, implementation, closure, and diagram/doc alignment.
diff_table.rationale: Keeps users at correct abstraction while preserving safety through gateway evidence.
diff_table.risk: High: needs strong audits, stale-ref scans, diagram-doc checks, content proof, and escalation policy.

diff_table.current_state: The self-refactor uses the current CodeWiki toolchain while changing concepts the toolchain depends on.
diff_table.desired_state: Run in bounded self-refactor compatibility mode: do not bypass CodeWiki, freeze public behavior except blockers, use current CodeWiki for traceability, implement vNext behind compatibility, and switch only after validation.
diff_table.rationale: Avoid bootstrapping drift while preserving alignment evidence.
diff_table.risk: Medium: freeze too strict stalls; freeze too loose mutates live flow under itself.

diff_table.current_state: CodeWiki exposes many low-level agent/user tools.
diff_table.desired_state: Reduce to fewer powerful public and agent workflow tools; move low-level build/diff/validation/status primitives behind orchestration and compatibility/deprecation boundaries.
diff_table.rationale: Smaller surface reduces tool-call count, mode confusion, and cognitive load.
diff_table.risk: High: over-consolidation can hide needed control or become too magical.

accepted_decisions.summary: Merge routine feedback and documentation into a Decision compiler and decision_build while preserving explicit user semantic approval.
Route accepted decisions by product/system abstraction layer with bidirectional propagation checks.
Treat system diagrams as the mandatory system ontology/navigation spine and require diagram-backed system docs.
Simplify the default state graph around Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof with full trace/audit expansion available.
Use parallel preflight/draft analysis only; keep canonical truth promotion serial.
Use risk-tiered gates so gateways validate lower-level artifacts and users approve only semantic decisions or escalations.
Run this refactor through current CodeWiki in compatibility/freeze mode rather than bypassing or changing live semantics mid-task.
Reduce the vNext tool surface to fewer public/agent workflow tools and move primitives internal.

assumptions: Current CodeWiki remains the safety harness during this self-refactor.
Legacy feedback/documentation/build/tool names remain available until vNext compatibility is validated.
Diagram YAML remains agent-editable and can be audited deterministically.
open_questions: Exact vNext public command names and agent tool names need planning.
Exact migration/deprecation schedule for existing codewiki_* primitives needs planning.
Exact diagram_ref schema and diagram node taxonomy need documentation and tests.
non_goals: Do not bypass CodeWiki entirely during the refactor.
Do not allow parallel canonical writers.
Do not remove compatibility aliases before replacement flows validate.
